verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official React CLI or starter template. React's docs send developers to third-party frameworks (Next.js, React Router) or third-party build tools (vite, parcel, rsbuild), and those are capabilities of other products. The online sandbox is a playground for experimenting, not a way to scaffold a project, so it is only adjacent support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and run a new project in just a few minutes using an official CLI or starter
